title: Nested Comprehensions & Advanced Patterns
instructions: Practice advanced comprehension patterns including nested comprehensions, set comprehensions, generator expressions, and know when to choose comprehensions over traditional loops.
steps: Flatten a 2D list using nested comprehension
Create a set of unique word lengths from a list of strings
Use a generator expression to find the first 5 even squares
Transform nested dictionary data using nested dictionary comprehension
Identify when a traditional loop would be better than a comprehension

hints: For flattening: [item for sublist in matrix for item in sublist]
Set comprehensions use {} and automatically remove duplicates
Generators use () and can be consumed with next() or in loops
For nested dicts: {outer_key: {inner_key: value for inner_key, value in inner_dict.items()} for outer_key, inner_dict in outer_dict.items()}
Consider readability and side effects when choosing between comprehensions and loops
